---
title: "Strategies"
---

ÇAHSPAR’s strategic approach focuses on developing lasting, effective and inclusive solutions in working life and social policy. The association plans its activities in line with scientific evidence, stakeholder views and society’s needs.

## Strategic Objectives

- Strengthen research output
- Expand training and capacity building
- Develop practical policy recommendations
- Increase collaboration
- Raise public awareness

These strategies increase the association’s contribution to social welfare and justice.
